GetRenewResourceList.queryAccountId: Account ID to query; if empty, defaults to the currently logged-in account. Only the primary account can query resource information for sub-accounts within its financial circle (or virtual operator organization); other query scenarios will return AccessDenied.
GetRenewResourceList.serviceType: Product type, e.g. BCC, EIP, etc. Only products that support auto-renewal are allowed.
GetRenewResourceList.region: Region, e.g. bj, su, gz, etc.
GetRenewResourceList.expiredDays: Number of days until prepaid resource expiration. Can be null (defaults to all resources). Must not be negative or greater than 90.
GetRenewResourceList.shortOrInstanceIds: List of resource short or instance IDs. These can be retrieved via order or monthly billing Open APIs.
GetRenewResourceList.pageNo: Page number for paginated queries, starting from 1. Default is 1.
GetRenewResourceList.pageSize: Maximum number of items per page, typically no more than 1000. Default is 100.
